subject.title: fix: reconcile timed-out gateway message actions

question: Is the common-case same-process reconciliation improvement acceptable even though a gateway restart can erase the in-memory idempotency record during the ambiguous delivery window?
rationale: Source inspection establishes safe joining within one gateway process, but only maintainers can decide whether that bounded guarantee is sufficient or durable exactly-once reconciliation is required before merge.

options.title: Accept after live proof
options.body: Merge after a real delayed-send run proves exactly one visible delivery, treating restart durability as separate follow-up work.

options.title: Require durable reconciliation
options.body: Pause until message-action idempotency survives gateway restarts through a broader persisted-state design.

recommendation.title: Accept after live proof
recommendation.body: Merge after a real delayed-send run proves exactly one visible delivery, treating restart durability as separate follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work introduced the current gateway in-flight join and completed-result replay behavior on which this decision depends.
